decisionRecord.issue: the required check typecheck wrote outside its declared paths (node_modules/.tmp/tsconfig.app.tsbuildinfo, node_modules/.tmp/tsconfig.node.tsbuildinfo, node_modules/.tmp/tsconfig.scripts.tsbuildinfo, node_modules/.tmp/tsconfig.test.tsbuildinfo) during validation, so it was not activated; the required check test wrote outside its declared paths (node_modules/.cache/imagetools/...) during validation, so it was not activated

diagnostic.mechanism: Before any model call the run validates each required check once in a scratch clone at the pin, with the dependencies installed. It rejects a check that writes a path the check does not declare in its `writes`. The conventions file the harness derives for each arm repository declared no `writes`, but `tsc -b` writes node_modules/.tmp/*.tsbuildinfo and vitest writes node_modules/.cache/imagetools (and, found by running the four checks in a clone, node_modules/.vite, node_modules/.vite-temp and node_modules/.vitest-cache). Two required checks were therefore rejected and the run blocked on a permission decision. The same cause blocks every arm and every portfolio task.
diagnostic.classification: harness defect (the arm repository setup, scripts/eval-retrieval.ts conventionsFor), not an AVARICE product defect and not a design decision: the product enforced its documented rule (a check declares what it writes) as designed, and `writes` is the conventions key meant for tool caches. Nothing under src/ changed.
diagnostic.fix: conventionsFor declares node_modules/.tmp/**, .cache/**, .vite/**, .vite-temp/** and .vitest-cache/** as `writes` of every check of a repository whose parent has an npm lockfile, and nothing for another repository. RED commit a0c1989 (two failing tests), GREEN commit e76f7cc. test/unit/eval-retrieval.test.ts 37 of 37, unit suite 2866 of 2866, typecheck and check:boundaries clean.
diagnostic.offlineCheck: the portfolio's four checks run in a clone of the kept repository with a copy of the owner's node_modules whose tool caches were removed: typecheck wrote node_modules/.tmp (4 files), test wrote node_modules/.cache/imagetools (14), node_modules/.vite/vitest and node_modules/.vitest-cache (76); lint and format:check wrote nothing. All are inside the declared globs. The clone and the kept scratch were removed afterwards; the owner's checkout and node_modules were only read.
diagnostic.notProvenOffline: that no second pre-model gate follows the check validation: the first portfolio-6 run is the test, and a shared stop halts the plan

offlineJudgeProbe.freeSuccesses: none: the held-out test fails at the parent for all 9 tasks, so no task succeeds without the agent's work
offlineJudgeProbe.portfolio: with the held-out test removed, `npm run test` at the T01 parent passes (14 files, 315 tests): portfolio tasks are judgeable. The judge needs --node-modules aa-phan-portfolio-v2=<checkout>/node_modules because the checkout's lockfile differs from each parent's (one extra dependency, lenis, at T01 and T04; 50 more packages and a different font package at T06).
offlineJudgeProbe.auto_search_workflow (T07, T10, T13): the required check and the held-out command run `python3 -m unittest` under the PATH python3, /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin/python3 3.9.6, which has no `requests` and no `gspread`. In the sandboxed judge T07's held-out dies with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'requests'` (boards.py line 19) in 0.5 s, whatever the agent did. The repository's own .venv holds the dependencies, but the harness has no way to use it. With the held-out file removed, the parent's suite outside the sandbox shows 1 failure and 5 errors (gspread, requests and a cross-process lock test). T10 and T13 use the same interpreter and suite; their held-out imports were not probed one by one.
offlineJudgeProbe.GroceriesGPT (T16, T17, T20): vitest's globalSetup requires TEST_DATABASE_URL (a dedicated Postgres) and throws without it; the judge environment holds PATH, HOME, TMPDIR, CI and LANG only. T16's held-out command dies in globalSetup in 1.4 s, whatever the agent did, so the required `test` check and the held-out test cannot pass. T17 also fails `npm run build` at the parent because the held-out test file is compiled by tsc (a natural failure the agent's work would clear).
offlineJudgeProbe.consequence: On 6 of the 9 approved-for-evaluation tasks (T07, T10, T13, T16, T17, T20) success is impossible for every arm in this harness, independent of retrieval. Only the three portfolio tasks (T01, T04, T06) can succeed.
